literature_notes: All three ledger clips (L1–L3) from PMC7064540 describe a single construct: GFP fused in-frame to the C-terminus of full-length Gpr176 (entire coding sequence without stop codon). The topology landmarks place the C-terminal tail (residues 324–515) entirely in the intracellular compartment. The confocal data in L3 confirm that the receptor traffics to the plasma membrane, but the GFP moiety faces the cytoplasm — this is an intracellular tag, not an extracellular surface tag. No ledger clip reports any insertion at the extracellular N-terminus (residues 1–42), ECL1 (101–118), ECL2 (183–203), or ECL3 (288–302). Because the rules prohibit proposing sites not grounded in the ledger, and the sole ledger evidence is for an intracellular C-terminal fusion, zero extracellular surface tag sites are reported.

literature_other_positions.note: GFP fused in-frame to the C-terminus of full-length Gpr176 (after residue 515); the entire C-terminal tail (residues 324–515) is intracellular per topology, so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
